The '''Return''' was a prophecy of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]]. It described how a group of legendary [[Skyborn|Protectors]] would come to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], and that the [[Destructors]], who had previously ravaged Kesh would return and fight the Protectors. They believed that the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who had crashed on Kesh, were the Protectors and that the Destructors had yet to return.
